farmStatusHelp: The administrative state of the registered farm. Active does not mean published. Archiving is tracked separately.
publicationHelp: Whether this farm has an authorized published Sale/Rent listing. Sale and Rent filters also include farms published for both.
invalidRange: Choose a valid start and end date. The end must be on or after the start.
hoverHint: Hover or focus a bucket to inspect its value
registryNote: Registered farms and marketplace listings are separate. Publishing a listing does not create another farm.
name: Farm name
ownerHint: Existing active user ID. The selected user becomes the declared owner; this does not verify legal ownership.
ownerPreserved: Existing ownership relationships will be preserved.
fieldError: Check required fields and enter a positive area with up to two decimal places.
confirmFarm: I confirm the farm details and declared owner are correct.
attachmentsRestricted: Facilities and private media use the existing owner/manager workflows. Staff access is not granted by this form. Exact coordinates stay private and are not edited here.
noDraft: This wizard saves only on final confirmation; there is no separate farm draft API.
archiveHelp: Only farms with no linked requests, evaluations, facilities or visits can be archived. History and ownership records are preserved.
archiveBlocked: This farm has linked records and cannot be archived safely.
scoreHint: Leave scores empty if not established. The maximum must be positive; the value must be between zero and the maximum.
scoreError: Enter a valid non-negative score no greater than a positive maximum.
requestIdError: Enter a numeric user ID, not a request number such as FL….
approvedNotPublished: Approval completes review. Publication is a separate authorized action that makes the listing public.
notEligible: Assignments and review decisions are available only while this listing is under FarmExit review.
casePrerequisites: Communication is opened only through an eligible mediated workflow and the assigned case agent. Viewing this page does not open a conversation.
casesUnavailable: Communication information is unavailable for this staff session.
privateMedia: Private media is available only through the authorized owner/manager workflow.
publicationNote: Published listings leave this approval queue. Find the farm in the registry and its listing in the public marketplace.
